about: CANDIDATE selection for the INT8x2 deployment default (plans/x2-default.md Y1, Z2). The gates (g0-g5), the recorded benchmark (b1-b6) and test scoring use THIS file explicitly (GPU1BIT_SELECTION / selection=). Promotion replaces shared/selected.json with a byte-identical copy of this file, after every gate passes and the benchmark is written; until then shared/selected.json stays the x3 document. Identities hash this file's content.

x3_selection.note: the kernel ranking was established at x3 only (plans/x2-default.md Scope)

selection.decision: user, 2026-10-21: INT8x2 becomes the deployment default, subject to the dev gates g0-g5
